name: Predictive Asset Maintenance Intelligence Agent
headline: Find the grid assets most likely to fail and plan the work before they do
summary: Give reliability engineers, maintenance planners and asset managers one conversational view of grid asset health: transformers, switchgear, cables and overhead lines ranked by 30, 90 and 180-day failure risk, preventive work orders drafted with the parts and crew they need, field records checked before the asset register changes, and the replacement plan with its capital.
capabilities: Rank assets by 30, 90 and 180-day failure risk
Draft work orders with history, parts and crew
Hold register updates until the record is complete
Show fleet health and replacement capital by year
value: Ranks grid assets by 30, 90 and 180-day failure probability, so crews work on the riskiest assets first.
Drafts preventive work orders with history, materials and the long-lead parts to order first.
Holds asset register updates until the field record is complete, and shows the replacement capital by year.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.title: Reliability Engineer: Risk ranking
scenarios.prompt: Which of our grid assets are most likely to fail in the next 90 days, and what's driving it?

scenarios.title: Maintenance Planner: Work order draft
scenarios.prompt: Get a preventive work order ready for the Millbrook transformer, with the parts and crew we need. Don't raise it yet.

scenarios.title: Reliability Engineer: Register update check
scenarios.prompt: The Mill Lane cable joint job closed yesterday. Is the field record complete enough to update the asset register?

scenarios.title: Director of Asset Management: Replacement plan
scenarios.prompt: For the investment committee, how healthy is the fleet and what replacements and capital do we need over the next few years?
